name: Haggai
summary: A prophet who brought the LORD's message to the people who had come back to Jerusalem. He stirred up Zerubbabel, Joshua and the people to build the house of the LORD again.

key_moments.title: Helps Rebuild God's House
key_moments.description: Haggai and Zechariah prophesied in the name of Israel's God to the Jews of Judah and Jerusalem. Then Zerubbabel and Jeshua started building God's house, and the prophets were with them, helping them.

key_moments.title: Stirs the People to Build the LORD's House
key_moments.description: Through Haggai the LORD asked why the people lived in fine houses while His house lay waste. They had sown much and brought in little, so Zerubbabel, Joshua and the people obeyed and began work on His house.

key_moments.title: Promises the New House Greater Glory
key_moments.description: Some thought the new house was nothing next to the old one. Through Haggai the LORD told them to be strong and work, and said this later house would have greater glory than the first.
